exposure: history of premature rupture of membrane
cohort: 115 cases with premature rupture of membrane and 230 controls without premature rupture of membrane at two public hospitals in Harar Town, Eastern Ethiopia
finding: History of cesarean delivery, history of premature rupture of membrane, history of abortion, and abnormal vaginal discharge were significantly associated with increased odds of premature rupture of membrane.
mod_finding: History of cesarean delivery was associated with increased odds of premature rupture of membrane.
